_hermes_python: Set $HERMES_PYTHON to the Python interpreter Hermes itself runs on (the one that imports hermes_cli, yaml and pydantic). This loop finds it for an install.sh install (PM environments under $HERMES_HOME/installs) and for a git checkout of hermes-agent (venv/bin/python): HERMES_PYTHON=$(for p in "${HERMES_HOME:-$HOME/.hermes}"/installs/*/environments/*/venv/bin/python "${HERMES_HOME:-$HOME/.hermes}"/hermes-agent/venv/bin/python; do "$p" -c 'import hermes_cli, yaml, pydantic' 2>/dev/null && echo "$p" && break; done). The hermes command itself is a shell launcher in both layouts, so its shebang does not name the interpreter.

claims.claim: The plugin test suite passes with 0 failures (Hermes Agent v0.23.0 checkout, venv Python 3.11.16, Linux; python-docx installed only so tests/test_docx.py can build .docx fixtures and diff the adapter's stdlib reader against the engine's python-docx reader — the plugin itself no longer needs it)
